jobs.description:
1 Technical Operator  Plant Operations & Maintenance (m/f/d) to keep our carbonation plant running day to day. You'll make sure the plant runs reliably, the material is prepared correctly and our trials are carried out cleanly. Because nobody is closer to the plant than you, you'll also become an important voice when it comes to developing it further.

We're headquartered in Vienna, with two additional technical sites in Vienna and Upper Austria; this position is based at our site in 4800 Attnang-Puchheim. Join an ambitious team and help take CO2 mineralization from pilot to industrial scale.

Key Responsibilities

Plant Operations

¿ Operate the carbonation plant according to operating instructions, including start-up and shutdown

¿ Monitor process parameters (pressure, temperature, CO2 supply, throughput) and respond to deviations following defined procedures

¿ Carry out test series together with our science team

¿ Take material and product samples according to the sampling plan

Material Preparation & Logistics

¿ Receive and store raw materials (industrial mineral residues)

¿ Prepare material as specified (e.g. screening, mixing, moistening, dosing) and feed it into the plant

¿ Move material with pallet truck and crane, optionally also with a forklift

Maintenance & Servicing

¿ Carry out inspections and maintenance according to the maintenance plan

¿ Dismantle and clean the plant and its components

¿ Replace wear parts and fix simple mechanical and electrical faults

¿ Support our engineers and external partners with modifications, extensions and the installation of new components (sensors, wiring, drives)

Documentation & Safety

¿ Keep operating and maintenance logs

¿ Jointly develop work and maintenance plans as well as instructions

¿ Ensure occupational safety, cleanliness and order at the plant and in the warehouse

¿ Bring in improvement ideas from day-to-day operations

Skills & Qualifications

¿ Motivation beats qualifications - if you like to get hands-on, think along and enjoy learning new things, we'll teach you the rest

¿ Completed technical college (HTL, ideally electrical engineering, mechatronics, mechanical or process engineering) or a technical apprenticeship; career changers with good manual skills are welcome too

¿ Experience in electrical work, assembly, installation or operating production plants is a clear advantage - we value commitment and reliability over years on the clock

¿ You can read circuit diagrams and technical drawings and find your way around controls (PLC/HMI) - or want to learn

¿ Careful, reliable and safety-conscious; you're happy to do physical work

¿ Nice to have: welding skills, English, crane licence, forklift licence (optional), qualified electrician certification, experience with bulk materials or pressure vessels

¿ Driving licence B, German skills (B2) and willingness to work occasional overtime

Why Join Us?

¿ Take on real ownership of "your" plant from day one and help shape how it runs and improves

¿ Work closely with a high-performing team of engineers and scientists in a fast-moving startup environment

¿ Variety between plant, workshop and office - no two days are the same

¿ Targeted training, e.g. crane and forklift licences, electrical and control engineering

¿ Grow with us: as we move to industrial scale, your responsibilities grow too

¿ Full-time position incl. workwear and personal protective equipment

¿ Fair salary: minimum € 2.173,58 gross per month (paid 14 times a year) under the collective agreement, with overpayment depending on qualifications and experience

¿ Earn a real stake in what you help build, through our employee participation programme
